corrections.reason: Knowing where food comes from and how it is prepared (g3-hlth-food-origins) is not needed to match nutrients to foods or explain why the body needs them. The direct need is knowing how foods are sorted into healthy groups, which is g2-hlth-food-guide-choices. Food origins is only loosely related and is not a required step.

Cultural foods (g3-hlth-cultural-foods) is not needed to read a food log and set a goal such as drinking water or eating more vegetables. The Food Guide basis is already covered through g4-hlth-nutrients, which depends on g2-hlth-food-guide-choices, so it should not be listed again here.

The skill explicitly asks kids to remember hand washing and tooth care, but the prerequisite list does not include any earlier hygiene or oral health skill. g2-hlth-oral-health covers tooth care and depends on g1-hlth-hygiene (hand washing and clean habits), so it is the direct prerequisite and g1-hlth-hygiene is already covered through it and should not be listed separately.

output.notes: Reviewed all 14 Grade 4 skills. Corrections were made only where a prerequisite was unnecessary, redundant with another listed prerequisite, or missing a directly referenced earlier skill. The remaining skills (g4-hlth-tech-risks, g4-hlth-bullying-abuse, g4-hlth-tobacco-substances, g4-hlth-puberty-changes, g4-hlth-smoke-vape-choices, g4-hlth-safe-decisions, g4-hlth-mental-health-choices, g4-hlth-healthy-eating-places, g4-hlth-smoke-effects, g4-hlth-managing-stress) have direct, non-redundant prerequisites that point only to earlier grades, and their titles and descriptions are suitable for reading aloud. No skill is missing a clearly needed prerequisite beyond those listed above.
